page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It includes 16.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is limited to a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the average category. However, multi-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by a stress-ng multi-core score of 4151.89 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 2941.0. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with uncached read and write speeds of 31.07 GB/sec and 25.1 GB/sec respectively, both ranking in the bottom 25% of benchmarks.

Given its dedicated hardware allocation but lower multi-threaded performance, this instance is best suited for workloads that rely on single-threaded execution or moderate compute requirements, such as basic web serving, text processing, or lightweight application hosting. It is less optimal for heavy database operations, parallelized software compilation, or high-throughput memory-bound tasks. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers dedicated Intel Xeon resources at an entry-level scale, though users must weigh the dedicated CPU allocation against its lower multi-core and memory bandwidth benchmark results.
